## Problem statement

What problem does this feature solve? What is the use case?

## Proposed solution

Describe what you'd like to see. Be as specific as possible.

## Alternative approaches

Have you considered any alternative solutions or workarounds?

## Additional context

Add any other context, screenshots, mockups, or examples that would help explain the feature.

## Priority

How important is this feature to your workflow?
- [ ] Critical — I can't use the plugin effectively without it
- [ ] High — It would significantly improve my workflow
- [ ] Medium — Nice to have
- [ ] Low — Minor quality-of-life improvement
